Circle.reason: Circle Line: Severe delays while we respond to a fire alert at Farringdon. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses.

Elizabeth line.reason: Minor delays between Hayes & Harlington and Heathrow Airport due to an earlier faulty train at Heathrow Airport. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Hammersmith & City.reason: Hammersmith and City Line: No service on the entire line while we respond to a fire alert at Farringdon. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate and SEVERE DELAYS between Harrow-on-the-Hill and Baker Street while we respond to a fire alert at Farringdon. London Underground tickets will be accepted on London buses. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Piccadilly.reason: PICCADILLY LINE: Tuesday 18, Wednesday 19 and Thursday 20 August, no service between Cockfosters and Uxbridge. Trains will continue to operate between Acton Town and Heathrow. Use METROPOLITAN LINE services between Rayners Lane and Uxbridge and DISTRICT LINE trains between South Kensington and Ealing Common. Replacement buses operate.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 30 August, no service between Arena and Elmers End at certain times. On Mondays to Fridays, no service before 0700 and after 1930, on Saturdays, no service before 0800 and after 1845, and on Sundays, no service for the whole day.

Windrush.reason: Windrush Line: No service due to a earlier fire in the Bermondsey area.
